scope: The frozen v04 evaluation matrix: which programs, which seeds and which resource limits every later measurement is taken under.
Data, not arguments. A measurement that does not name an entry here is not part of the matrix.
A change to this file is a recorded configuration revision, never a silent gate relaxation: bump `revision` and say why in the run that first uses it.

build.scope: The 250k cap is the comparison point. The 1.5M cap is a separately labelled experiment and never rewrites a 250k comparison.
build.required_scale_flags_scope: A scale measurement without bounded growth allocation is not comparable to one with it: without --scale-budget the connected pass reserves no per-function allocation and never rolls back, and unchanged zlib then passes 2.2M instructions where the retained v03 evidence stayed under 1.5M. The runner refuses a locked corpus run that omits these flags rather than silently producing an incomparable number.

container.scope: Must equal what conformance.process.Runner actually passes to docker; the accounting tests assert that, so a drift in either is a failure rather than an undocumented change.

agent.scope: A timeout is a censored observation, not infinite hardness. Three runs are an initial variability check, not a statistical proof.

seeds.scope: The three sets are disjoint by construction and the loader checks it. A held-out seed is not a held-out program: another seed of the same program is still the same program family.

tuning.description: Programs candidates may be designed and tuned against.

scale-regression.description: zlib, Lua and SQLite have already influenced this work. They are scale continuity regressions, not fresh evidence of generalization, and must never be described as held-out.

holdout.description: Results are reported and never used to tune the same candidate. Rotating an entry into tuning requires reporting its original holdout result first and replenishing the split.

notes: Burrows-Wheeler transform, MTF and Huffman coding with bit-level I/O: a different codebase and a different kernel shape from zlib.

Clean references only were compiled while freezing this contract, after the first experimental bundle checkpoint and before protected holdout evaluation. No candidate measurements or protected holdout results were used for tuning.

acquisition.stability_caveat: A GitHub-generated tag tarball. If upstream regenerates it the hash can change without the source changing. Record the mismatch and re-pin deliberately; never overwrite this value silently.

cjson.workload_contract: Clean-verified line-oriented parse/serialize and invalid-document contracts; frozen 2026-09-18
notes: Recursive-descent parsing and serialization over heap object graphs with aliased pointers: the recursion and aliasing shape that M3 and M5 claim to support, in code that never influenced the design.

The upstream sources are unchanged; a public generic CLI driver defines the protocol. Clean references only were compiled after the first experimental bundle checkpoint and before protected holdout evaluation. No protected holdout measurement was performed.

honest_reporting: A missing denominator is null, never zero.
Coverage is never inferred from a flag being enabled; only measured numerators count.
Emitted counts, AST size, taint-set size, nominal family count and decompiler output length are diagnostics, not protection.
Where a run cannot establish something it says unknown and exits non-zero rather than defaulting to a pass.
